messages:
Maya - CS: Heads up: pushing a small CRM hygiene sweep tonight to flag stale contacts and sync onboarding statuses to the playbook engine. ETA 10pm PT. Anyone on call?

Jonah (CS Ops): which field are you using to mark 'stale'? last_activity? we should avoid touching lead_source.

Maya - CS: using last_activity < 90d + owner IS NULL. will set stale_contact = true and trigger 'reengage' playbook. We'll run dry-run first.

Priya - CSM: please exclude "Enterprise" accounts with active renewals. Also don't change owner for accounts in "onboarding: in progress".

Samir - RevOps: Add me. I'll run a dry-run SQL to preview. SQL:
```
SELECT account_id, owner_id, last_activity
FROM salesforce.contact
WHERE last_activity < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND owner_id IS NULL
  AND account_tier != 'Enterprise';
```

Evan (Data Eng): I can add a webhook to push updates to the playbook engine. sample payload:
```
{
  "account_id": "001xx000003NGsY",
  "stale_contact": true,
  "reason": "last_activity_90d",
  "detected_at": "2026-03-18T02:15:00Z"
}
```

playbook-bot: Playbook 'reengage' queued (dry-run) for 1,324 accounts. No actions taken.

Maya - CS: thanks — schedule the real run after 10:30pm if dry-run matches expectations. @Samir please confirm counts.

Samir - RevOps: Dry run summary: total flagged 1,324; excluded Enterprise 74; will upload CSV to #customer-success once I have it. Link: https://redwood.example/reports/dryrun-183250

Priya - CSM: :thumbsup: Also request we set field healthscore_decay_reason = 'stale_contact_sweep' for auditability.

Maya - CS: good call. playbook rule snippet:
```
name: reengage_stale_contacts
trigger: on_data_change
filters:
  - stale_contact == true
  - account_tier != 'Enterprise'
actions:
  - create_task: template=reengage_email
  - set_field: { name: healthscore_decay_reason, value: 'stale_contact_sweep' }
```

Maya - CS: I'll add rollback plan and runbook to the ticket. If anything spikes, ping @eng-oncall. I'll monitor logs during the run.

Jonah (CS Ops): noted. please drop final CSV in #customer-success after run.

Maya - CS: will do. thanks everyone, night team handling.
